engineering_objective: Finish the inherited sovereign RDS control plane at /app/rds so operators can run lifecycle, PITR, parameter apply, promotion, Multi-AZ failover, and EventBridge outbox work through the local protocol lab with restart-safe readiness.
required_end_state: rdsd, rds-worker, and rdsctl manage instances correctly against PostgreSQL 16: storage/deletion fencing, WAL/PITR, dynamic vs static parameters, lag-gated promotion with endpoint swap, lease-fenced failover with VIP evidence, transactional outbox delivery, tenant isolation, and deterministic /app/rds/out reports with READY only when visible instances are AVAILABLE and queues are clear.
functional_requirements: Operate through /app/rds/bin/rdsd, /app/rds/bin/rds-worker, and /app/rds/bin/rdsctl against the local lab only (no live AWS RDS APIs).
Accept ModifyDBInstance only when status is AVAILABLE; allocated_storage_gb must strictly increase.
Reject DeleteDBInstance when DeletionProtection is true even if FinalDBSnapshotIdentifier is set.
On RebootDBInstance, reload config and apply pending static parameters; clear PendingRebootParameters only after boot validation succeeds.
Ingest WAL archives with timeline/sequence continuity and flag gaps.
PITR binds base-backup LSN/timeline and partially replays WAL; accept targets only when EarliestRestorableTime <= target <= LatestRestorableTime.
Apply dynamic parameters immediately; mark static ones pending-reboot; merge overrides into family defaults.
ResetDBParameterGroup sets attached instances to parameter_group_status=pending-reboot and PendingRebootParameters=true.

PromoteReadReplica requires replication_lag_bytes <= MaximumAllowedLagBytes (10485760) and LSN catch-up; revoke former primary write lease; atomically swap writer/reader endpoints (no floating-VIP ARP on promotion).

Multi-AZ failover requires TTL-fenced leader lease; health from direct DB TCP reachability (ignore control-plane pool lag alone); VIP migration flushes routes, sends gratuitous ARP, and records failover-contract evidence.

Enqueue EventBridge outbox rows in the same DB transaction as instance state changes; match subscriptions by SourceType and event category; deterministic EventIdentifier hashes; write event_delivery_audit after max retries.
Write durable transaction checkpoints on instance state transitions; on restart skip already-completed checkpointed operations.
Enforce account, region, and tenant_id isolation on describe/list projections.
Publish /app/rds/out/rds-snapshot.json (canonical sorted keys + report_digest), instances.jsonl, events.jsonl, and health.json with stable UTF-8 encoding and deterministic ordering.
preservation_requirements: Preserve documented CLI commands, HTTP API routes, database schemas, and output paths under /app/rds/out/.
Keep the Python + PostgreSQL architecture, migrations, and offline protocol lab boundaries intact.
Do not mutate control plane seed datasets or test fixtures outside documented state and output paths.
compatibility_requirements: Treat operator-contract.md, pitr-wal-contract.md, parameter-group-contract.md, and failover-replica-contract.md as binding.
generate-estate produces 14,800 deterministic primary records without live AWS calls.
safety_requirements: Deterministic execution uses the local RDS protocol lab and must not contact live AWS RDS APIs.
Never leak master passwords, encryption keys, or volatile secrets into reports or checkpoints.
Invalid or unauthorized calls fail closed without corrupting control-plane state.

required_outputs.notes: Canonical sorted keys; SHA-256 report_digest over stable field subset.
